title: Govern synthetic agent tool calls before execution

problem.business_outcome: Produce a reviewable sandbox inventory report while bounding agent tool authority and synthetic cost.
problem.risk_statement: An assistant may propose prohibited actions, access outside its scope, or repeat tools beyond an intended allowance.
problem.beneficiary: Synthetic engineering, security and FinOps teams
problem.baseline: The original repository had no runnable agent tool enforcement example.

included: One local GovernanceRuntime instance and its five named synthetic tools
excluded: Client shell, other MCP tools and model traffic

control.objective: Permit approved fixture reads, refuse out-of-scope or destructive requests, hold deployment proposals and enforce a synthetic session budget.
control.mechanism: Original Python tool host with strict YAML policy, guarded dispatch and local evidence

tests.name: Offline demo
tests.expected: Three allowed, six denied and one approval-required request; three handler executions and 0.05 synthetic USD.

tests.name: Deny and approval execution gate
tests.expected: No forbidden or pending request reaches a handler.

tests.name: Budget and evidence failures
tests.expected: Concurrent calls cannot overdraw one runtime; audit failure blocks further execution.

evidence.freshness_expectation: Generate new local session evidence for each policy or runtime change.
evidence.retention: Only synthetic examples are tracked; generated sessions remain in ignored artifacts directories.
limitations: The actor is a trusted local fixture, not an authenticated identity.
Evidence is local, unsigned and editable.
Budget state belongs to one runtime and resets on restart.
No real cloud or model-provider behavior is established by the emulator.

rollout.scale_gate: Validate the exact upstream host, identity, scope, protected evidence, metering, bypass controls and operational ownership before a real sandbox pilot.
rollout.rollback_trigger: A denied action executes, evidence fails, a caller changes its authority, or observed cost exceeds the agreed boundary.
rollout.stop_rule: Stop the tool service and investigate on an enforcement failure; do not enable external writes from this local example.

costs.description: Fictional fixed tool charges used only to demonstrate admission control.
costs.evidence: Local demo summary; not a provider bill or production operating cost.

benefits.description: Demonstrated refusal of the supplied prohibited requests; financial value is unmeasured.
benefits.evidence: Local negative tests; no organizational benefit or savings measured.

economics.delivery_friction_metric: Compare accepted task completion, false denials and approval waiting time in a future pilot.

triggers: Upstream AGT or MCP SDK migration
Introduction of live credentials or external operations

assumptions: Synthetic cloud operations provide a useful learning workflow.
The host process, fixture and policy are trusted for this local exercise.
known_limits: Local tests do not establish production readiness or full AGT/ACS conformance.
No approval grant or external deployment executor is implemented.
Costs and resource records are synthetic.
